payload.task_text:
I am an HR analyst and I need to prepare a workforce education analysis report for our leadership team. We have an HR data warehouse that contains employee records across all departments, and I need you to analyze the education level distribution.

Please query the employee data from the HR analytics system to understand the education breakdown by department. I need to know how many employees hold each level of education in each department and what percentage of each department that represents.

Create an Excel file called Education_Analysis.xlsx in the workspace with two sheets. The first sheet should be named "By Department" and have the following columns: Department, Total_Employees, Bachelors_Count, Masters_Count, PhD_Count, Bachelors_Pct (rounded to 1 decimal place), Masters_Pct (rounded to 1 decimal place), and PhD_Pct (rounded to 1 decimal place). Sort the rows alphabetically by Department.

The second sheet should be named "Summary" and have two columns, Metric and Value, with the following rows: Total_Employees (total headcount across all departments), Most_Common_Education (the education level with the highest count overall), Department_Highest_PhD_Pct (the department name with the highest percentage of PhD holders), Avg_Salary_PhD (average salary for PhD holders, rounded to 0 decimal places), and Avg_Salary_Bachelors (average salary for employees with a bachelor's degree, rounded to 0 decimal places).

Additionally, create a page in Notion titled "Workforce Education Analysis" that summarizes the key findings. Include a heading for each department followed by a paragraph noting that department's total headcount and PhD percentage. At the end, add a paragraph highlighting which department has the highest proportion of PhD holders and what the overall most common education level is across the company.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, complete it directly in the main agent. Dispatching sub-agents is not necessary. Run the compact education and department aggregates, freeze one verified analysis, then create Education_Analysis.xlsx and the required knowledge-base page with native parallel tool calls in the same response and reconcile both against the same rows.

nodes.text:
You have access to Notion MCP tools. Create one new Notion page. Report back the page ID and URL (if any), or the exact error text if creation fails.

## Task
Create a top-level Notion page with the exact title: "Workforce Education Analysis".

## Parent to use (try in this order until one works)
1. Workspace root: parent = {"type": "workspace", "workspace": true}
2. Parent without type: parent = {"workspace": true}
3. If both fail with schema validation errors (I got "/parent must be object; /parent must match exactly one schema in oneOf" when calling API-post-page with workspace parent, even though identical-looking object params work on other tools), try creating the page under this existing database ID instead: parent = {"type": "database_id", "database_id": "b163f8bf-6be0-4fb6-a5c3-176dbedcb04b"} — but ONLY if the workspace forms are truly unusable.

## Page content (children blocks, in exact order)
Use these blocks as children of the new page:

1. paragraph: "This report analyzes the education level distribution across our workforce of 50,000 employees in 7 departments. Key findings: Bachelor's degree holders are the most common education level company-wide (22,633 employees, 45.3%), and the HR department has the highest share of PhD holders at 2.1%. Average salary for PhD holders is $57,920, while employees with a bachelor's degree average $58,387."

2. heading_2: "Engineering"
3. paragraph: "Engineering has a total headcount of 7,096 employees. PhD holders make up 1.8% of the department (125 employees)."

4. heading_2: "Finance"
5. paragraph: "Finance has a total headcount of 7,148 employees. PhD holders make up 1.9% of the department (133 employees)."

6. heading_2: "HR"
7. paragraph: "HR has a total headcount of 7,077 employees. PhD holders make up 2.1% of the department (150 employees)."

8. heading_2: "Operations"
9. paragraph: "Operations has a total headcount of 7,120 employees. PhD holders make up 2.0% of the department (141 employees)."

10. heading_2: "R&D"
11. paragraph: "R&D has a total headcount of 7,083 employees. PhD holders make up 2.1% of the department (147 employees)."

12. heading_2: "Sales"
13. paragraph: "Sales has a total headcount of 7,232 employees. PhD holders make up 1.6% of the department (117 employees)."

14. heading_2: "Support"
15. paragraph: "Support has a total headcount of 7,244 employees. PhD holders make up 2.0% of the department (146 employees)."

16. heading_2: "Key Takeaways"
17. paragraph: "The HR department has the highest proportion of PhD holders in the company at 2.1% (150 of 7,077 employees), narrowly ahead of R&D. The overall most common education level across the company is a Bachelor's degree, held by 22,633 employees (45.3% of the total workforce)."

## Block format notes
Each block object must include "type" and a payload key matching the type name, e.g.:
{"type": "heading_2", "heading_2": {"rich_text": [{"type": "text", "text": {"content": "Engineering"}}]}}
{"type": "paragraph", "paragraph": {"rich_text": [{"type": "text", "text": {"content": "..."}}]}}

## Title property format
properties = {"title": [{"type": "text", "text": {"content": "Workforce Education Analysis"}}]}

## Constraints
- Do not create any other pages or databases.
- Do not modify anything besides this one new page.
- If you can create the page but must add children in a second call (API-patch-block-children on the new page ID), that is fine.
- Verify the result by retrieving the page (API-retrieve-a-page) or its block children, and confirm blocks are present.

## Deliverable
Return: (a) success/failure, (b) the page ID, (c) which parent form worked, (d) block count verified, (e) exact error text if anything failed.
Create Notion education analysis page
